title: Great Ways to Experience Local Food
text: Finding the location to meet for the tour was challenging.  Seville has very narrow streets where your phone GPS program does not get coverage.  Make sure you have a physical map.  We took the Tapas and History tour and it was excellent.  It was our first day in Seville and gave us an overview of the history of the area.
author: Boisenb

title: Tapas Tour
text: Maria, the host, for the Tapas tour was amazing. She made the whole experience fun, lovely, informative and engaging but was also such a delight to hang out with. She introduced me to some great places and I’d definitely do the tour with her again!
author: Daniel_H

title: What a fantastic evening - great food and wine and tour guide
text: My wife and I were the only people on the tour whcih we thought might have been a bit awkaward but Juan our guide was a star.  Very engaging, very knowledgeble and and fantastic host for the evening.  We started at s sherry bar where we tried 4 different type of sherry which got the evening off to a great start.  Then 3 tapas bars each with 3 different types of tapas in each and a glass of wine.  Then we ended up on the rooftop terrace of a hotel with a glass of orange wine overlooking the cathedral.  We had a truly memorable evening thanks to Juan.  Highly recommended!
author: Paul T

title: Gourmet Tapas and Wine Tour
text: Juan was an amazing tour guide.   We loved the places he took us to.  Each was unique and the food was marvelous.  He explained some history without going overboard.  The only suggestion I might offer is to focus the wine selections on choices not so sweet.    Save the sweet stuff until the end.
author: Pathfinder166121

title: Muy bien
text: A very friendly and awesome guide, started by the cathedral and made our way across various stops with each unique characters. Some places we wouldn’t have found ourselves. Ended with a surprise on a rooftop bar. Great pick of food & wine. Sadly we both forgot the mans name, but his wife was Chinese. A great tour.
author: re_Bassetti

title: Thanks to Adele!
text: We booked the tapas and wine tasting tour not knowing exactly what to expect. We were met by lovely Adele and discovered that we were her only guests for the evening tour. The next three hours passed in a flash. Adele was the absolute perfect host, keeping us fully engaged with her knowledge of the history of Seville along with interesting facts about the food and wine that we were tasting. We visited four very different restaurants and tried a total of 7 tapas with accompanying wines. The whole evening was very relaxed and thoroughly enjoyable. So, a huge thank you to Adele for a fabulous eve
author: Steve L

title: Thanks Lara/Lola...
text: We were the only guests on our tour and Lara Croft (aka Lola) took us to four unique spots we would never have found on our own.  In the first place we had Sherry, which was strong but gave us a lift for the evening.  We also had some small Tapas.  Next stop was for Rioja and more snacks.  Third location was Ribera and more Tapas.  I had Pig cheek which was delicious (like a stewed beef).  Last stop was a roof top deck for Cava and a sweet snack with a view of the Giralda Tower.  Funny that we seemed to walk quite a lot but when we finished we were within 100 yards/metres from where we started
author: Ciffs_travels
